provenance: Workshop bank: 200 musical descriptions from prompts-v3 plus 56 emotional/atmospheric listening invitations. Context and mood phrases express possible subjective associations, not verified facts or listener emotion predictions. Retired prompts and their measured coverage remain recorded. No song/artist names or numbered template filler.
